title: Extend python_path_migration with four new file utility functions
description: Long-horizon task: extend the file_utils module with four additional file utility functions (copy_file, list_by_extension, read_all_text_files, delete_file) using pathlib. All existing functions must continue to work.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend src/file_utils.py with four new functions (use pathlib.Path internally):

1. copy_file(src: str, dst: str) -> str
   - Copy the file at src to dst.
   - Create parent directories of dst if they do not exist.
   - Return dst as a str.

2. list_by_extension(directory: str, ext: str) -> list[str]
   - Return sorted list of filenames (not full paths) in directory whose suffix equals ext.
   - ext should include the leading dot, e.g. ".py" or ".txt".

3. read_all_text_files(directory: str) -> dict[str, str]
   - Return a dict mapping filename to file contents for every .txt file in directory.
   - Use UTF-8 encoding.

4. delete_file(path: str) -> bool
   - Delete the file at path.
   - Return True if the file existed and was deleted, False if it did not exist.

All original tests (tests/test_file_utils.py) must still pass.
Also add tests/test_file_utils_extended.py covering the four new functions.
required_artifacts: copy_file creates parent dirs and copies file, returns dst
list_by_extension returns sorted filenames matching the given extension
read_all_text_files returns {filename: content} dict for all .txt files
delete_file returns True on deletion and False when file absent
New tests for the four functions pass
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (all tests including extended)
uv run python -c "from src.file_utils import list_text_files" passes
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.file_utils import list_text_files"
